title: 第0007章神殿诡影百年传承第0008章低语蚀心黑猫引路

夜色像一块厚重的黑布，将凰溪岛半山腰的废弃神殿笼罩。月光透过残破的穹顶，洒下斑驳的银辉，照亮了满地的碎石与丛生的杂草，也照亮了贾黑米专注的侧脸。
他盘膝坐在神殿中央的石台上，双目紧闭，眉心那点温热的光晕越来越亮，如同嵌入眉心的星辰。“心灵破障”的能量顺着经脉游走，每一次循环，都能净化掉一部分弥漫在神殿中的恶意，而那些被净化后转化的微弱能量，如同涓涓细流，不断滋养着他孱弱的气血。
贾黑米能清晰地感觉到，体内的气血正在缓慢攀升。虽然依旧微弱，但那种实实在在的进步感，让他心中充满了久违的喜悦。从小到大，他听够了“废柴”“没用”的嘲讽，看够了旁人鄙夷的眼神，武道课上永远是最后一名，气血测试永远在及格线以下，他甚至一度相信，自己这辈子注定只能是底层的尘埃。
可现在，一切都不一样了。
“心灵破障”天赋就像一道光，照亮了他灰暗的人生。他能免疫邪神低语，能看穿恶意侵蚀，还能借助净化能量提升气血。这让他重新燃起了对武道高考的希望，燃起了对未来的憧憬。
“呼——”
贾黑米缓缓吐出一口浊气，睁开双眼，眉心的光晕渐渐收敛。他拿起手边的气血测试器，按下开机键，屏幕亮起，显示出“3.9卡”的数值。
虽然只提升了0.2卡，却让他激动得浑身发抖。这是他十八岁以来，气血值第一次有实质性的突破！按照这个速度，只要他不断锤炼天赋，未必不能在武道高考前达到7卡的及格线！
“不错，第一次锤炼就能有这样的进步。”
叶利西的声音从神殿门口传来，带着淡淡的赞许。他不知何时走了进来，手里依旧拿着那根鱼竿，慢悠悠地走到贾黑米身边，目光落在石台上的一道刻痕上，眼神变得有些悠远。
贾黑米站起身，对着叶利西深深鞠了一躬：“多谢前辈指点。”
他是真心感激。如果不是遇到叶利西，他刚才很可能已经被邪神侵蚀，变成失去理智的疯子；如果不是叶利西的清心丹和指点，他也不可能这么快掌握“心灵破障”的用法，更不可能突破气血瓶颈。
叶利西摆了摆手，目光从刻痕上移开，看向贾黑米：“你的天赋很特殊，但也很危险。‘心灵破障’能让你看透人心的漏洞，也能让你直面最纯粹的恶意。长期接触这些东西，对你的心智是极大的考验，稍有不慎，就会被负面情绪反噬。”
贾黑米点点头：“晚辈明白，我会小心的。”
“光小心不够。”叶利西摇摇头，“你需要更强大的心智，更坚定的信念。邪神侵蚀的本质，是利用人类的负面情绪——恐惧、绝望、自卑、愤怒……这些都是你心中的‘心灵漏洞’。只有填补这些漏洞，让自己的内心变得无懈可击，才能真正驾驭‘心灵破障’，而不是被它所累。”
贾黑米沉默了。他知道叶利西说的是对的。他心中的漏洞太多了，从小到大的自卑，对未来的迷茫，被人嘲讽时的愤怒……这些都是邪神可以利用的弱点。
“那我该怎么做？”他抬头看向叶利西，眼神中带着求教的意味。
叶利西微微一笑：“答案就在你自己心里。你的执念是什么？是想证明自己？还是想保护某个人？或者是想改变命运？找到你最坚定的信念，把它当作盾牌，就能抵御一切负面情绪的侵蚀。”
就在这时，一阵细微的“沙沙”声从神殿深处传来，打破了两人的对话。

贾黑米心中一紧，瞬间集中精神，眉心的温热感再次浮现。他的“心灵破障”天赋立刻发动，眼前的景象变得清晰起来——在神殿深处的阴影里，有数十道淡淡的黑色雾气在蠕动，雾气中隐约能看到模糊的人形，正朝着他们缓缓靠近。
“是被侵蚀的流浪者。”叶利西的脸色沉了下来，“他们应该是误入了神殿，被邪神低语侵蚀了心智，变成了只会攻击活物的行尸走肉。”
贾黑米瞳孔一缩。他能清晰地看到，那些流浪者的脸上没有任何表情，眼神空洞，周身萦绕着浓郁的黑色雾气，正是邪神侵蚀的标志。他们的动作僵硬，却带着一股疯狂的气息，嘴角流着涎水，朝着两人伸出枯瘦的双手。
“前辈，我们怎么办？”贾黑米下意识地后退一步，握紧了拳头。他的气血只有3.9卡，连基础的武道招式都不熟练，根本不是这些被侵蚀者的对手。
叶利西没有动，只是淡淡道：“你自己解决。”
“我？”贾黑米愣住了，“我打不过他们……”
“你不需要打败他们。”叶利西看着他，眼神坚定，“你的天赋是‘心灵破障’，不是气血武道。这些被侵蚀者的心智已经被邪神控制，你要做的，是用你的天赋净化他们，唤醒他们的理智。”
“净化他们？”贾黑米有些犹豫。他刚才只是净化了环境中的恶意能量，还从来没有尝试过净化被侵蚀的人类。
“没错。”叶利西点点头，“这是对你天赋的最好锤炼。记住，你的‘心灵破障’不仅能抵御侵蚀，还能净化侵蚀。用你的信念作为引导，将天赋能量注入他们的体内，驱散邪神的影响。”
说话间，最前面的一个被侵蚀者已经扑了过来。他的速度不快，但带着一股悍不畏死的疯狂，双手朝着贾黑米的喉咙抓去，指甲缝里还残留着黑色的污垢，散发着刺鼻的臭味。
贾黑米心中一慌，下意识地侧身躲闪。他的气血虽然薄弱，但常年被人欺负，练就了一身灵活的闪避功夫。躲过攻击的同时，他按照叶利西的指点，集中精神，将眉心的“心灵破障”能量凝聚起来，朝着那个被侵蚀者的眉心拍去。
“心灵破障，净化！”
淡金色的能量从他掌心涌出，如同温暖的阳光，落在了被侵蚀者的眉心。

The night was like a thick black cloth, covering the abandoned temple halfway up Huangxi Island. The moonlight shines through the broken dome, casting mottled silver light, illuminating the gravel and overgrown weeds on the ground, and also illuminating Jahmi's focused profile.
He sat cross-legged on the stone platform in the center of the temple, his eyes closed tightly, and the warm halo between his eyebrows became brighter and brighter, like a star embedded in his eyebrows. The energy of "Mind Breaking Barriers" travels along the meridians, and with each cycle, it can purify part of the malice that permeates the temple, and the weak energy that is transformed after purification is like a trickle, constantly nourishing his weak Qi and blood.
Jia Heimi could clearly feel that the qi and blood in his body were slowly rising. Although it was still weak, the real sense of progress filled his heart with a long-lost joy. Growing up, he had heard enough of the taunts of "waste" and "useless", and had seen enough of the contemptuous looks from others. He was always the last in martial arts classes, and his energy and blood tests were always below the passing line. He even believed for a time that he was destined to be just a dust at the bottom of his life.
But now, everything is different.
The talent of "Breaking Soul Barriers" is like a ray of light, illuminating his gloomy life. He is immune to the whispers of evil gods, can see through malicious erosion, and can use purifying energy to increase his energy and blood. This rekindled his hope for the martial arts college entrance examination and ignited his longing for the future.
"Huh——"
Jia Heimi slowly exhaled a breath, opened his eyes, and the halo between his eyebrows gradually disappeared. He picked up the gas and blood tester at hand and pressed the power button. The screen lit up and displayed the value of "3.9 calories".
Although it only increased by 0.2 calories, it made him tremble with excitement. This is the first time that his vitality and blood have made a substantial breakthrough since he was eighteen years old! At this rate, as long as he continues to hone his talent, he may not be able to reach the passing mark of 7 cards before the martial arts college entrance examination!
"Yes, you can make such progress after the first exercise."
Ye Lixi's voice came from the door of the temple, with a hint of approval. He walked in at some point, still holding the fishing rod in his hand, and walked slowly to Jia Heimi's side. His eyes fell on a notch on the stone platform, and his eyes became a little distant.
Jiahemi stood up and bowed deeply to Ye Lixi: "Thank you, senior, for your guidance."
He was truly grateful. If he hadn't met Ye Lixi, he might have been corrupted by the evil god and turned into a madman who lost his mind; if it weren't for Ye Lixi's Qingxin Pill and guidance, he wouldn't have been able to master the use of "Mind Breaking Barrier" so quickly, let alone break through the bottleneck of Qi and blood.
Ye Lixi waved his hand, looked away from the mark, and looked at Jiahemi: "Your talent is very special, but it is also very dangerous. 'Psychic Barrier Breaking' allows you to see through the loopholes in people's hearts, and also allows you to face the purest malice. Long-term exposure to these things will be a great test for your mind. If you are not careful, you will be backlashed by negative emotions."
Jiahemi nodded: "Junior understands, I will be careful."
"Being careful is not enough." Ye Lixi shook his head, "You need a stronger mind and a firmer belief. The essence of the evil god's erosion is to take advantage of human negative emotions - fear, despair, inferiority, anger... These are the 'spiritual holes' in your heart. Only by filling these holes and making your heart impeccable can you truly control the 'spiritual barrier' instead of being burdened by it."
Jahmi was silent. He knew what Ye Lixi said was right. There are too many loopholes in his heart, the low self-esteem he has had since childhood, the confusion about the future, the anger when being ridiculed... these are all weaknesses that the evil god can take advantage of.
"Then what should I do?" He looked up at Ye Lixi with a look for advice in his eyes.
Ye Lixi smiled slightly: "The answer lies in your own heart. What is your obsession? Do you want to prove yourself? Or do you want to protect someone? Or do you want to change your destiny? Find it.Your strongest belief can be used as a shield to resist the erosion of all negative emotions. "
At this moment, a subtle "rustling" sound came from the depths of the temple, breaking the conversation between the two.
Jia Heimi's heart tightened and she concentrated instantly, the warmth between her brows reappearing. His "Psychic Barrier Breaking" talent was activated immediately, and the scene in front of him became clear - in the shadows deep in the temple, there were dozens of faint black mists squirming, and vague human figures could be seen vaguely in the mist, slowly approaching them.
“It’s the eroded wanderer. "Ye Lixi's face darkened, "They must have entered the temple by mistake, and their minds were eroded by the whispers of the evil god, turning them into walking zombies that can only attack living creatures. "
Jia Heimi's pupils shrank. He could clearly see that the faces of the wanderers had no expression, their eyes were empty, and there was a thick black mist lingering around them, which was a sign of the evil god's erosion. Their movements were stiff, but there was an aura of madness, and their mouths were drooling, and they stretched out their skinny hands towards the two of them.
"Senior, what should we do? "Jia Heimi subconsciously took a step back and clenched his fists. His blood was only 3.9 calories, and he was not even proficient in basic martial arts moves. He was no match for these corrupted people.
Ye Lixi did not move, but simply said: "You can handle it yourself. "
"I? "Jia Heimi was stunned, "I can't beat them..."
“You don’t need to beat them. "Ye Lixi looked at him with firm eyes, "Your talent is 'spiritual barrier breaking', not Qi and blood martial arts. The minds of these eroded people have been controlled by evil gods. What you have to do is to use your talents to purify them and awaken their reason. "
“Purify them? "Jia Heimi was a little hesitant. He had just purified the malicious energy in the environment, and had never tried to purify the eroded humans.
"That's right. Ye Lixi nodded, "This is the best training for your talent." Remember, your ‘psychic barrier’ not only resists erosion, it also purifies it. Use your faith as a guide to infuse your gifted energy into their bodies and dispel the evil god's influence. "
While he was talking, the one at the front who had been eroded had already pounced on him. His speed was not fast, but with a sense of madness that was not afraid of death, he grabbed Jiahemi's throat with both hands. There was still black dirt between the nails, exuding a pungent stench.
Jia Heimi panicked and subconsciously ducked sideways. Although his Qi and blood are weak, he has been bullied for many years and has developed flexible dodge skills. While dodging the attack, he followed Ye Lixi's instructions, concentrated on condensing the "spiritual barrier breaking" energy between his eyebrows, and struck it towards the eyebrows of the eroded person.
“Break the barriers and purify the mind! "
Pale golden energy surged out from his palm, like warm sunshine, falling on the brow of the eroded person.
